name: n8n Workflow
author: hearth-team
description: Orchestrate n8n automations from Hearth. Create, list, activate, trigger, and inspect workflows on your own n8n instance (cloud or self-hosted). Use this when the founder wants to wire third-party systems together (Slack, Gmail, Notion, custom webhooks, etc.) or set up a recurring automation that needs more than a single skill call. Pass `action` ∈ list/get/create/update/delete/activate/deactivate/trigger/executions plus the action-specific args.

vault_inputs.label: n8n base URL
vault_inputs.help: Your n8n instance URL — `https://yourname.n8n.cloud` for n8n Cloud, or `http://localhost:5678` / your self-hosted address. Do NOT include `/api/v1` — the handler appends that.

vault_inputs.label: n8n API key
vault_inputs.help: Generate at n8n → Settings → API → Create API key. Stored encrypted in the vault. Sent as `X-N8N-API-KEY` header on every call.
